falsification_conditions.condition: BTC/USD closes above $72,500 on any daily candle within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A close above $72,500 would break the lower-high structure that defines the current HOLD/bottoming pattern, indicating the market has already transitioned into a new uptrend rather than consolidating for a further decline.

falsification_conditions.condition: Total crypto market cap (excluding BTC) gains more than 15% in a single 7-day rolling period while BTC dominance drops below 48%
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would show risk-on rotation into altcoins at a scale inconsistent with a pre-bottom or early-bottom phase, suggesting the bottom is already in and the market is in early expansion, invalidating the HOLD signal.

falsification_conditions.condition: Bitcoin spot ETF net inflows exceed $1.5 billion in any single week within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained institutional buying of that magnitude would signal strong demand absorption, making a further leg down unlikely and contradicting the 74% similarity to the August 2024 bottom pattern, which was characterized by weak or negative flows before the final low.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
